name: popover
title: Popover
description: Displays rich content in a portal or inline, triggered by a button.

docs.lead: Displays rich content in a portal or inline, triggered by a button.
docs.usage:
import { Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent } from "@/components/ui/popover"

<Popover>
  <PopoverTrigger>Open</PopoverTrigger>
  <PopoverContent>Content here</PopoverContent>
</Popover>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A simple popover with trigger button and content.

examples.title: Inline (No Portal)
examples.description: Popover rendered inline without a portal, useful inside modals.

api.name: Popover
api.description: The root popover component (Radix UI Root).

api.name: PopoverTrigger
api.description: The trigger element that opens the popover.

props.name: usePortal
props.description: Whether to render in a portal. Set to false for modal integration.

props.name: align
props.description: The alignment of the popover relative to the trigger.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: The distance in pixels from the trigger.
